description: This file defines the GuzzleHttp Client class, implementing HTTP client functionality with support for asynchronous and synchronous requests, configuration management, and request handling, serving as a core component for HTTP communications within the project.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: A PHP HTTP client implementing PSR-18, facilitating HTTP requests with support for various configurations and request methods, both synchronous and asynchronous.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Client with optional configuration, setting up defaults, handler, and base URI.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method to handle dynamic request method calls, supporting asynchronous and synchronous variants.

methods.name: sendAsync
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request asynchronously with provided options and returns a Promise.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request synchronously, waiting for the response.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request following PSR-18, ensuring specific request options are set.

methods.name: requestAsync
methods.description: Creates and dispatches an asynchronous HTTP request with specified method, URI, and options.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Creates and dispatches a synchronous HTTP request with specified method, URI, and options.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves client configuration options, including defaults and base URI.

methods.name: buildUri
methods.description: Constructs the full request URI based on base URI and options.

methods.name: configureDefaults
methods.description: Sets up default client configuration options including proxies, headers, and cookies.

methods.name: prepareDefaults
methods.description: Merges default options with request-specific options, handling headers and null values.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Handles the request transfer process using a handler and returns a Promise.

methods.name: applyOptions
methods.description: Applies request options to modify a PSR-7 request object, supporting headers, body, auth, query, and other settings.

methods.name: invalidBody
methods.description: Creates an exception for unsupported array body in requests.
